surface_name: cacheComponents prerender of time, random and crypto
title: Build fails with 'encountered the unstable value crypto.randomUUID()' after enabling cacheComponents
symptoms: Route "/account": Next.js encountered the unstable value `crypto.randomUUID()` while prerendering.
The same error for `new Date()`, `Date.now()` or `Math.random()`
Setting instant = false on the route does not make the error go away
cause: With cacheComponents, Next.js prerenders a static shell and treats time, randomness and random bytes as IO that would freeze into it. Auth libraries often call crypto before reading headers, so the error points at code you did not write.
fix: Wrap the part that needs the value in Suspense and call await connection() before the call so it runs per request, or cache it with use cache, or move it into a Client Component.
affected: Next.js 16.x with cacheComponents: true (reproduced on 16.4.1 with Auth.js)
